name: cron_job
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname = 'ten280-bet105-drop-bot'

name: cron_last_runs
sql: select d.status, d.return_message, d.start_time, d.end_time - d.start_time as took from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using (jobid) where j.jobname = 'ten280-bet105-drop-bot' order by d.start_time desc limit 10

name: cron_failures_24h
sql: select count(*) filter (where d.status <> 'succeeded') failed, count(*) runs from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using (jobid) where j.jobname = 'ten280-bet105-drop-bot' and d.start_time > now() - interval '24 hours'

name: live_alerts
sql: select tier, delivery, count(*) n, min(eval_at) first, max(eval_at) last from ten280_bot.alerts where mode = 'live' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: live_recent
sql: select eval_at, delivery, message from ten280_bot.alerts where mode = 'live' order by id desc limit 10

name: events
sql: select kind, delivery, created_at from ten280_bot.events order by id desc limit 5
